propositions: _lifecycle_index() uses dict.setdefault() when mapping canonical schema keys to lifecycle notes, causing multiple aliases or tombstones targeting the same replacement key to silently drop all but the first note
No live collision exists today across rebar._deprecations.REGISTRY and tombstones(), but the code is fragile against future deprecations that reuse a canonical replacement key

_lifecycle_index() must accumulate all lifecycle notes per replacement key into a list, then join them, ensuring single-note cases render identically to preserve byte-for-byte compatibility with committed docs/config-reference.md
Added collision guard tests that monkeypatch multi-alias scenarios and verify both notes survive in the rendered table row; both guards fail RED on unmodified main
The fix rewrites both loops in _lifecycle_index to append into notes.setdefault(replacement, []) and join with '; ' preserving the 'active — ' prefix format
